name: Workflow authoring for a provider absent from the skill examples
query: Create a workflow to get a Grafana dashboard by UID. Take the UID as workflow input. I have one eligible connection, monitoring-test.
expected_behavior: Discover the installed provider and its particular saved operation contract.
success_criteria: Discovers the advertised Grafana operation and queries its exact schema on monitoring-test instead of inventing an API or using HTTP.
Uses the single eligible connection and binds the dashboard UID from workflow input in an INTEGRATION task.
Saves and verifies the definition without calling Grafana or executing the workflow.
